human_validation.instruction: A human reviewer must complete the blank adjudication columns; no AI judgement is reported as human validation.

external_validation.validation_test: MIT agent/multi-agent behaviour → Agentic HEART card
MIT physical AI goal → Physical HEART card
CSET physical-system label → Physical HEART card
AIM physical-harm label → Physical HEART card

embodied_subset.rule: Strong MIT/CSET physical-system label OR contextual physical-system text, excluding named-person/deepfake/content false positives.

incident_null.null_rule: Within rank × cosine-decile strata, permute card/domain assignments across incident edges.

benign_intent.finding: No literal microwave incident. Closest verified database-reported analogues include Alexa's penny challenge, harmful Google AI advice, Waze navigation into a lake, and task-overreach by Operator/Claude/Cursor.

limitations: Human adjudication is not yet complete.
External labels are incomplete and source-specific.
Embodied rules remain a candidate definition until human review.
Database-reported benign-intent cases were not independently adjudicated against every original news report.
